textos_alternativos: Cover: Tipping in Brazil, who and how much
Restaurants: the 10% service line on the bill is the tip, optional by law; some places charge 12 to 15%
Typical tips: round up taxis, R$ 5 a bag for porters, R$ 5 to 10 a day for housekeeping, up to 10% for a great guide, 10% at bars with table service
Four checks before paying: find the service line, live music charge only if announced, check the card machine, ask staff to fix errors

legenda:
Tipping in Brazil: the 10% on your bill is already the tip 💸
🍽️ Restaurants: 10% "serviço" on the bill, optional by law (some charge 12–15%)
🚕 Taxis: just round up
🧳 Hotel porter: about R$ 5 a bag (≈ US$ 1)
🛏️ Housekeeping: R$ 5–10 a day (≈ US$ 1–2)
🧭 Great tour guide: up to 10%
🎶 Live music charge only if it was announced first
